card.name: Fixture Agent
card.description: Deterministic A2A v1.0.1 agent with no language model, driven by the prefix of the first text part. Covers the lifecycles no official sample exercises.

skills.name: Echo
skills.description: Answers with a direct Message (no Task) carrying the text back verbatim.

skills.name: Long task
skills.description: Runs a Task through SUBMITTED, WORKING and COMPLETED, emitting one artifact. `slow:` holds the task in WORKING so it can be canceled.

skills.name: Ask for input
skills.description: Parks the Task in INPUT_REQUIRED with a question, then completes it when a second message carrying the same taskId supplies the answer.

skills.name: Terminal outcomes
skills.description: Drives a Task straight to REJECTED, FAILED or AUTH_REQUIRED, each with an explanatory status message. `vanish` opens a Task, moves it to WORKING and then forgets it, so the next GetTask raises TaskNotFoundError. `error: <code>` makes SendMessage fail with the typed A2A error of that code, from -32001 TaskNotFound to -32009 VersionNotSupported.

skills.name: Non-text parts
skills.description: Completes a Task whose single artifact holds a DataPart, a url file part or raw bytes, exercising every arm of the v1.0 Part oneof.
